Should those also be explained?

- TOTP "Time-based One Time Password"
  - better to use "time-based OTPs" like in V2.8.1 and V2.8.4
- FIDO "Fast IDentity Online"
- U2F "Universal Second Factor" or "Universal 2nd Factor"
- PBKDF2 "Password-Based Key Derivation Function 2"
- PSTN "Public Switched Telephone Network"
- RP "relying party"
- WYSIWYG "What You See Is What You Get"
- SSRF "Server-Side Request Forgery"
- HQL "Hibernate Query Language"
- ORM "Object-Relational Mapping"
- XXE "XML External Entity"


## OTP

One Time Password (OTP) is defined in V2.8 category description but used earlier

- V2.2.6
- V2.2.7
- V2.5.7

and "One Time Password (OTP)" is never explained inside a requirement

## TPM
- Used already in V2.9.1
- explained in V2.10.4 trusted platform module (TPM)

comments.body: Are any of these in the glossary?
Can you please rephrase the questions, I'm not sure I can understand it correctly.
Don't we have subsections explaining some of those acronyms, no?

@csfreak92  from your question I expected, that I have missed something and double checked. The answer is no.

- Now there is SSRF used (because of #798)
- RP is descibed in 3.6 section description.

Anyway, this was my question and take it as discussion - should we explain (write them out once) those or not? There is always some "expectation from reader", we don't need to explain what HTML means I guess.
@elarlang I meant are these acronyms included in the glossary section of the ASVS: https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/en/0x90-Appendix-A_Glossary.md
No, listed initials/acronyms does not exist in any latest .md file or generated v4.0.1 PDF file.
So do you think they should be added to the glossary?
Yes, all acronyms and initials should be to explained in the document.
OK so please create PRs for 4.0.2 and 4.1 to add these to the glossary.

I agree with Elar; thank you for this! 🙏 

--
Jim Manico
@Manicode

I can put those acronyms there, but it requires some explanations also...
Good point about the explanations. Open a PR against 4.1, add as many explanations as you feel you can and I will add the rest and then I will figure out how to drag the change back to 4.0.2 🙃
Hi @elarlang, please could you open this PR against master :) I can then go in and update as necessary.
This is something which I have started many times but never reached anywhere (additionally to just search and write out those acronyms). Reality is that no PR from me for this one...
Hi @elarlang, please could you review PR #832 and let me know if you have any comments.

Definitely it's a improvement.

Glossary itself does not follow only one rule or pattern how to describe acronyms, new ones:
```
**Fast IDentity Online** (FIDO) - A set of authentication ...
```

Some old ones:
```
**SAST** – Static application security testing (SAST) 
```

If to go through every item one-by-one, then we can have a lot of discussions how to write certain acronym or explanation (like `Server-side` vs `Server-Side`).

Ok I have fixed the pattern thing but I don't want to get into discussions on every single one at this point.
Any other key points?

> I don't want to get into discussions on every single one at this point.

Yes, I agree, that's why I said "If". I think it's a bit bigger topic and should be covered/synchronized over different OWASP projects.

Issue closed for me.
